description: This file is a shell script for testing git clone directory name outputs. It sets up test cases to verify that cloning repositories with various URL formats results in the expected local directory names, including handling of SSH URLs, trailing slashes, '.git' suffixes, and authentication details.

methods.name: test_clone_dir
methods.description: A function that tests whether cloning a given repository URL results in the creation of an expected directory. It supports options for bare repositories and failure expectations.
